owner must pay contract price and other money payable under contract in manner and at times stated in contract
obligations apply to each owner individually and all owners as a group
communication to owners only has to be given to one owner
one owner may sign quote, notice, instruction, direction or other communication to bind all owners; deemed signing on behalf of all owners
evidence of ownership includes copy of certificate of title to site
owner must within initial period give builder written proof that owner owns or is otherwise entitled to build on site
written details of any encumbrances, covenants, easements and caveats affecting site
if required, written evidence that security account has been established and amount required to be paid into security account is held in clear funds

if owner obtaining finance from lending body, written advice from lending body that amount of finance plus owner's own available funds is sufficient to pay contract price, and building works may commence
if owner is named in Item 11 of Schedule 1, written evidence of development consent for building works
if required, written proof that owner has obtained any building approvals and has satisfied any conditions imposed by statutory or other authority where required prior to commencement of work
if required, written proof that owner has appointed principal certifying authority and has paid any costs associated with such appointment
written proof that all of owner's other statutory obligations listed in Item 9 of Schedule 1 have been satisfied
if owner fails to satisfy all above within initial period, builder may end contract by giving owner written notice to that effect at any time prior to physical commencement of building works
if builder ends contract, owner must pay builder price of services provided and works carried out to date contract ended
price includes builder's margin applied to costs incurred by builder, including cost of materials on site or already ordered from suppliers that are non-returnable
